$comment: Routing table, cross-validated against the INSTALLED driver by scripts/check-docs.mjs. That checker derives the tool list from `cua-driver list-tools` at run time and fails if the version here does not match, if a documented tool is absent, or if a refusal code observed in practice is missing. It found the deprecated-tools/deprecated-params conflation and six missing refusal codes when it was first written.

backend.fallbackPolicy: capture-only: never use for type_text, key, or click once cua-driver is available

delivery.$comment: The driver is explicit that background is mandatory-first. Do not pre-emptively foreground.

observation.get_window_state: tree AND screenshot in one call; capture_mode deprecated and ignored
observation.get_accessibility_tree: cheap discovery, processes and visible windows, no screenshot
observation.get_desktop_state: whole display, for targets spanning displays

elementTokens.snapshotRule: one get_window_state per turn per (pid, window_id) before any element action
elementTokens.invalidation: the next snapshot of the same (pid, window_id) supersedes it; old ids listed in invalidated_snapshot_ids

captureId.purpose: binds x,y pixels to the observation that produced them

effects.$comment: Action facts are NOT task outcomes. Even confirmed only means publishable readback exists; the task postcondition still needs separate checking. This is the driver's own WORKFLOW.md rule.

unverifiable.meaning: delivery cannot prove effect; the app may echo a write it did not apply
unverifiable.observedOnWin: Calculator button and pixel click both returned unverifiable while demonstrably changing state; type_text on a Notepad Document returned confirmed

refused.meaning: the route deliberately did not deliver

escalation.$comment: A suggestion, never authorization and never an automatic retry.

verifyState.$comment: For expressible postconditions. unknown is NOT success.
verifyState.webContentText: stays unknown with untrusted_source; read from a fresh snapshot instead

neverReplay.$comment: An interrupted transport may have delivered input before losing its response.
neverReplay.rule: never replay a cancelled, partial or unknown action automatically
neverReplay.textSpecific: after unverifiable text, take a fresh snapshot first; a deferred provider may publish after the call returns and an immediate retry can duplicate the text

coordinateSpaces.$comment: The most reliable way to get capture_coordinate_invalid.
coordinateSpaces.pixelWithCaptureId: window-local screenshot pixels; local = frame - window_bounds.origin

noWaitTool.$comment: There is no wait/sleep tool in 0.34.0.

typeTextConfirmation.$comment: type_text with element_token writes via ValuePattern and reads back by handle. confirmed only when the complete expected value is synchronously visible.
typeTextConfirmation.deferredProvider: a stale read-back means take a fresh snapshot before retrying, not retry harder

stale_element_token.do: re-observe; the element route still works
stale_element_token.observed: verify-input, probe-policy-arguments, four separate scripts across two phases

capture_coordinate_invalid.do: check which of the THREE coordinate spaces you are in. A capture-bound pixel click is validated in the SCREENSHOT's pixel space, which is the window scaled to max_image_dimension. Pass max_image_dimension 0 for native pixels.
capture_coordinate_invalid.observed: verify-phase4-pixel: with max_image_dimension 900 an 828x1064 window is downscaled to ~700x900 and window-local (718,1002) is refused as out of range

permission_denied.do: read the reason. Three different causes share this code: the tool is outside the manifest allow.tools, the tool is outside the policy allow list, or the tool has no reviewed risk classification.
permission_denied.observed: probe-policy-enforcement (zoom, launch_app), probe-browser-dom (browser_screenshot: no reviewed risk classification), verify-bounded (get_browser_state under allow.tools)

bounded_resource_outside_manifest.do: widen the manifest deliberately, never silently. Also check WHICH executable owns the window: app scope matches the window-owning executable, not the one you launched.
bounded_resource_outside_manifest.observed: verify-bounded, and Phase 4 where calc.exe did not authorise Calculator

authorization_required.do: needs a launch grant or a host decision
authorization_required.observed: browser_prepare against a logged-in Chromium profile

browser_requires_setup.do: no owned endpoint exists. browser_prepare only PREPARES an endpoint; get_browser_state with the prepared browser's (pid, window_id) is what mints target_id and tab_id. Take the remedy the refusal names: allow_launch with an isolated profile.

foreground_unavailable.do: the Windows foreground lock refused activation from a process that does not own the current foreground window. Check whether a foreground window exists at all; on this host bring_to_front with AttachThreadInput also fails, so the pixel rung cannot complete.

tool_invocation_failed.do: the action did NOT take effect. Treat the accompanying Win32 text as unreliable: a background pixel click on a UIA-less app returns this code carrying S_OK (0x00000000) while nothing changes on screen.
tool_invocation_failed.observed: verify-phase4-pixel, probe-foreground-escalation. The S_OK is the PostMessage return, not the click's effect.

foreign_process_termination_denied.do: the driver refuses to kill a process it did not launch. Do not reach around it with Stop-Process: that is how this project destroyed the user's unsaved Notepad tabs.

background_unavailable.do: re-issue that same action with delivery_mode foreground
background_unavailable.observed: not observed on this host; documented by the driver

background_occluded.observed: not observed on this host; documented by the driver

background_uipi_blocked.do: stop and ask the user; never bypass
background_uipi_blocked.observed: not observed on this host; documented by the driver

windowsBackgroundSupport.$comment: Empirical, from cua docs/action-support.md. This is an expectation table, NOT a selection table: always attempt background and let the driver refuse. 'unproven' means assume nothing either way.

secrets.action: refuse to type; ask the user

boundedMode.$comment: Measured on Windows. Two distinct refusal codes identify which layer fired.

refusalCodes.permission_denied: allow.tools: the tool NAME is not listed
refusalCodes.bounded_resource_outside_manifest: resources: the tool is allowed but the RESOURCE is out of scope

desktopDisplayMustBeTrue.why: with false, list_windows, list_apps, get_accessibility_tree, click and type_text are all refused as 'desktop display observation is outside the capability manifest'; the agent cannot learn a pid, so the manifest deadlocks
desktopDisplayMustBeTrue.meaning: may the agent see the desktop at all, not merely may it screenshot the whole display

boundedMode.realBoundary: resources.apps, matched against the executable that OWNS the window, not the one launched
boundedMode.packagedAppTrap: Calculator's window is owned by ApplicationFrameHost.exe, not calc.exe; check list_windows app_name before writing an app entry
boundedMode.failsClosed: no manifest, or a manifest without approval, refuses startup rather than degrading to standard

deprecated.$comment: TOOLS present in 0.34.0 but deprecated. Do not call.
deprecated.escalate_session: capture-scope legacy; scope is now explicit per call
deprecated.page: legacy browser compatibility; use browser_prepare then browser_*

cheatSheet.see: target in tree with an action

deprecatedParams.$comment: PARAMETERS, not tools. Kept apart because conflating them is how this table listed capture_mode as if it were a tool, and the checker caught that.
deprecatedParams.get_window_state.capture_mode: deprecated AND ignored; choose modality at action time by passing an element_token or x,y
